title: LangBot authenticated RCE via STDIO MCP server configuration (CVE-2026-54449)
summary: LangBot (PyPI: langbot) through 4.10.5: any authenticated user can achieve arbitrary command execution on the LangBot server by adding an 'STDIO' MCP server with an arbitrary command in the MCP Server Configuration — the command is passed to StdioServerParameters and executed on the host. No fixed release was available at publication.
